list_posts.description: Read a feed of posts: one community's, or everything your server can see. Each post comes back with its title, its text, the link it points at, its score, its comment count and its author's handle, plus its own address so a later step can link to it. Sort by what is busy, what is new or what is top this week. Set 'Only what is newer than' to the newest post from your last run and a scheduled workflow will only ever see what it has not seen before.

description: Read Lemmy, the open network of community forums, from a workflow. Watch a community's posts, pull a whole discussion in reading order, search every server your own one can see for a name or a topic, look up a community before you post in it or a person before you act on what they said, and follow a community's public moderation log. Every result carries the handle and the link a later step needs, so a scheduled workflow can turn a community into a digest, a keyword into an alert, or a thread into a summary. Set 'Only what is newer than' and a run never reports the same post twice. Every action reads: nothing here posts, votes or subscribes. No account or API key required.
